==Mythos Source==
The Dark Pharoah is a renaming of the Black Pharoah, who first appeared in ''The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath'' (1927), written by H.P. Lovecraft.

== Clarification ==
You can still use weapons and you still make a combat check, it is however based on [[Lore]] instead of [[Fight]].
